caption: Three women are standing in front of a picture of a woman dressed in traditional Indian garb. The woman on the right is wearing a red saree with a gold necklace and earrings. She is holding a brown bowl in each of her hands. Her face is painted with red and white paint. Her hair is pulled back in a ponytail. Behind the women on the left is another woman wearing a saree. Behind them is a large statue of lord Ganesha. The statue is surrounded by white smoke.
